claims.evidence: Witness photos show boxed items with PS5/4PS markings and game labels (e.g., “GHOSTWIRE”, “FIFA 22”), but do not show disc condition or whether they are PS4 vs PS5 versions.
Photos show retail-style boxes with printed labels/barcodes, but do not show whether discs are sealed/new or opened.
Witness report indicates visible “PS5” and “4PS” markings on packages; no “PS6” evidence is reported.

risks.risk: Wrong platform/version (PS4 vs PS5 vs region lock) leading to unusable discs for the buyer’s console
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the disc label side and the box back showing platform (PS4/PS5) and region/compatibility.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed/uncertain compatibility and treat as potentially not playable on the buyer’s console.

risks.risk: Discs may be missing, damaged, or not included (boxes shown but disc condition not shown)
risks.proof: A short clip opening one box and showing the disc(s) inside (front and back) plus a close-up of any scratches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: discs not guaranteed / untested.

risks.risk: Installation/working condition unknown (scratches, read errors, or corrupted data)
risks.proof: A video of the disc being inserted and recognized on a PS4/PS5 (whichever matches the box), showing it loads to the menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as untested and potentially non-working.

risks.risk: Incomplete packaging (missing manuals/inserts) or damaged cases
risks.proof: Photos of the full contents laid out from one complete box (case, inserts/manuals) and close-ups of case condition.

risks.risk: Quantity/title mismatch (some labels not fully readable; exact titles count unclear)
risks.proof: A single overhead photo showing all boxes with readable titles, or a written list of titles with counts matching the photos.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: fewer/less valuable titles than expected.

proof_requests: Confirm whether each item is PS4 or PS5 (take clear photos of the box back and the disc label side).
Open 1–2 boxes on video to show the discs are present and show close-ups of disc surfaces (scratches/marks).
Show a short test video where the disc is inserted and loads to the game menu on the correct console.
Provide a complete list of titles and counts (or a photo where every title is readable).
Show whether cases are complete (manuals/inserts) and close-ups of any damaged packaging.
response.reason: The witness can identify boxed game labels and PS5/4PS markings, but cannot verify disc inclusion, working condition, or exact platform/region. Without those missing shots, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
